sources.title: French modelling scout linked to Epstein found dead
supported_record: Reuters reported that Daniel Siad was found dead at his home outside Paris.
Reuters reported that the Nanterre prosecutor's office opened a cause-of-death investigation and ordered an autopsy.
Reuters reported that Siad's name appeared nearly 2,000 times in released DOJ Epstein-related files.
Reuters reported allegations by multiple women and Siad's denial, and carried his lawyer's statement that he had not been formally subjected to judicial proceedings.
limitations: The report does not establish cause or manner of death.
